title: Protocol pack manifest
description: The file inventory of one protocol pack: every shipped file with its SHA-256, plus the pack's declared permission summary and network requirement. A downloader can verify the pack byte-for-byte against this manifest before running anything.

network_required.description: True only if the protocol cannot deliver its output without a network call. A copy-and-run edition must be false.

declared_permissions.description: The distinct permission classes declared in protocol.yaml, surfaced here so a reviewer sees them without parsing the whole record.

role.description: What the file is for. Scripts and adapters are the security-relevant roles.
